text: Figure 13.3: Example SW composition with mapping information The atomic SwComponentPrototypes ‘A1’, ‘A2’, ‘B1’ and ‘C1’ are mapped to ‘ECU A’. The atomic SwComponentPrototypes ‘A3’, ‘B2’ and the empty composition ‘SWCompC‘ are mapped to ‘ECU B’. The data sent from • ‘A1’ to ‘A3’ is mapped to ‘PDU_X’, ‘SignalX1’, • ‘B1’ to ‘B2’ is mapped to ‘PDU_X’, ‘SignalX2’ and • ‘A3’ to ‘B1’ and ‘A3’ to ‘SWCompC‘ is mapped to ‘PDU_Y’, ‘SignalY1’ • ‘SWCompC‘ to ‘C1’ is mapped to ‘PDU_Z’, ‘SignalZ1’ As usual, the data mapping rules refer to the VariableDataPrototype in the PPortPrototype of the sending SW component. Note that DataMappings can be performed on compositions and on atomic SwComponentPrototypes as described in chapter 5.2.1. 2
